title: ui-extracting: create progress animation
description: Create a progress animation component that displays during the extracting phase of Progressive Discover. Shows visual feedback as artifacts are being extracted from the codebase, including animated progress indicators and status messages.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display a progress animation during artifact extraction
THE SYSTEM SHALL update the animation state based on extraction progress

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL animate the progress indicator to reflect current completion percentage
THE SYSTEM SHALL initialize the progress animation with starting state

unwanted.condition: IF the animation frame rate drops below 30fps
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT block the main thread
unwanted.because: UI responsiveness must be maintained during extraction

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT continue animating progress
unwanted.because: Resources should be freed immediately on cancellation

preconditions: Progress value must be between 0 and 100
Animation component must be mounted in the DOM
postconditions: Progress animation reflects current extraction percentage
No memory leaks from animation frames
invariants: Animation state remains consistent with extraction state

happy: Given extraction starts at 0%, when progress updates to 50%, then animation shows 50% complete
Given extraction is at 50%, when progress reaches 100%, then animation completes with success state
Given extraction is in progress, when animation renders, then progress bar animates smoothly
error: Given invalid progress value of -1, when animation renders, then it clamps to 0%
Given invalid progress value of 150, when animation renders, then it clamps to 100%
Given extraction fails mid-progress, when error occurs, then animation shows error state
